name: duckdb
description: In-process analytical SQL database management system for OLAP workloads

duckdb.description: Fast analytical SQL database with rich SQL syntax - single dependency-free executable for CSV/JSON/Parquet analysis
duckdb.usage:
duckdb
duckdb database.db
duckdb :memory: -c "SELECT * FROM 'data.csv'"
duckdb -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 'data.parquet'"
